name: gizza-ai/waveform-image
summary: Render a static waveform PNG image from an audio file

tool.description: Render a static waveform PNG image from an audio file (any format ffmpeg decodes: mp3, wav, flac, ogg, m4a, opus, ...). Provide either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref (id from a prior tool call). width x height set the image size in pixels (default 1200x300); color is the wave's hex color (default #4f46e5; alpha via #RRGGBBAA; a comma-separated list colors split channels); color2 turns the wave into a horizontal color->color2 gradient; background is an optional hex (empty = transparent PNG); split_channels draws one lane per channel instead of a single mono wave; scale (lin|sqrt|cbrt|log) boosts quiet audio's visibility; sampling=peak draws the loudest sample per column for a fuller wave. Output is always a PNG image.

background.description: Background color as hex: #RGB, #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA — e.g. #000000, or #00000080 for a see-through scrim. Empty or omitted keeps the background transparent (the PNG has an alpha channel).

color.description: Waveform color as hex: #RGB, #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA (alpha), e.g. #4f46e5 or #f00. With split_channels, a comma-separated list colors each channel (e.g. #ff0000,#0000ff). Default #4f46e5.

color2.description: Optional gradient end color (same hex forms). When set, the wave is filled with a horizontal left-to-right gradient from color to color2; color must then be a single value. Empty = solid color.

height.description: Output image height in pixels, 16-2048. Default 300. With split_channels the height is divided across the channel lanes.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

sampling.description: Per-pixel-column sampling. average (default) draws the mean amplitude; peak draws the loudest sample — a fuller wave that keeps short hits visible. Default average.

scale.description: Amplitude scale. lin is the true waveform; sqrt, cbrt and log progressively boost quiet audio so it stays visible. Default lin.

split_channels.description: Draw each audio channel in its own horizontal lane instead of downmixing to one mono wave. Default false.

url.description: Audio URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

width.description: Output image width in pixels, 16-4096. Default 1200 (the common social-banner shape with the default height).
